cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've arranged lunch for just us. That disastrous family reunion did us a favour; we'll put what we learned to work today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. An audience made us compete. You can start today, and I'll order while you settle in. Nobody has to win the table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter asked if we're expecting twelve more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him two. I'll explain the change, and you can keep your turn. That reunion taught us to make room for each other before anybody has to storm out.

reason: Make A direct a revised small gathering and concede first speaking time, then use B booking question to enact the claimed lesson of the failed reunion.
